package.name: odin1_tf_adapter
package.description: Rewrites the Odin1 driver's TF output into a REP-105 compliant tree (map -> odom -> base_link -> imu -> lidar -> camera), inverting the driver's odom -> map transform, inserting base_link, and optionally prefixing frames. Also publishes a LocalizationStatus derived from the presence and freshness of map -> odom.
